issues.issue: The top-center text “Stopped — one piece is missing” is very low-contrast against the dark vault and ceiling lights at 720p.
issues.fix: Increase opacity/contrast or place it on a darker backing panel so the message is clearly readable.

issues.issue: “nf-core/sarek” is presented in repository-path style with a slash, which pushes against the high-level/no-code-or-file-like-label rule.
issues.fix: Use the required example name in plain language, e.g. “nf-core Sarek,” without repository-path styling.

issues.issue: The “SCANNED” pills are status badges. Owner rules say there should be no status badges and the only allowed tag is “ILLUSTRATION.”
issues.fix: Remove the “SCANNED” badge styling; show security scanning as plain explanatory text or checkmark list instead.

issues.issue: The small “finding” pills are additional tags on screen, violating the rule that the only tag allowed is “ILLUSTRATION.”
issues.fix: Remove the “finding” tags or replace them with non-tag visual markers.

issues.issue: The small “finding” labels are also too small to read comfortably at 720p.
issues.fix: If the concept must remain visible, use larger plain text or a clearer icon without tiny lettering.

issues.issue: The “SCANNED” pills remain visible as status badges, which violates the no-status-badges rule.
issues.fix: Remove the badge treatment during the wipe as well.

issues.issue: The small “finding” tags remain visible, but the only allowed tag is “ILLUSTRATION.”
issues.fix: Remove the “finding” tags or replace them with non-tag visual markers.

issues.issue: The mismatch illustration still shows the faded “REGISTERED ready to run” stamp behind the rejection message, which conflicts with the accuracy rule that a mismatch stops the release before registration.
issues.fix: Remove the registered stamp entirely from the mismatch moment, or replace it with a clearly rejected/stopped visual.

issues.issue: The faded “REGISTERED ready to run” stamp remains visible during the fingerprint-mismatch rejection, creating a contradictory claim.
issues.fix: Do not carry the registered stamp into this wipe; fade it out before the mismatch message appears.

issues.issue: The ten CodePipeline stage boxes are crowded across the width, and several stage labels are small at 720p.
issues.fix: Enlarge the stage row, split it into two rows, or reduce secondary detail so each gated stage label remains readable.

issues.issue: The dashed private/offline boundary is clipped by the left edge and runs very close to the top navigation, which makes the framing feel cramped.
issues.fix: Inset the boundary from the frame edges and keep it clear of the navigation bar.

issues.issue: The “FAIL” option is very low-contrast against the dark panel at 720p, even though the film’s answer is supposed to be clearly PASS or FAIL.
issues.fix: Increase the contrast of the inactive FAIL option while keeping PASS visually selected.

issues.issue: Some timeline labels, especially “Verified every file, every image,” sit over bright sky and have reduced contrast at 720p.
issues.fix: Add a subtle shadow, darker backing, or reposition the labels over a darker area.

issues.issue: The far-right “Backed by evidence” timeline label is small and close to the edge, making it weaker than the other summary labels at 720p.
issues.fix: Move it slightly inward and/or increase label size and contrast.

review.overall: Main compliance issues are the prohibited status/tag treatments in the GitLab scanning frames and the contradictory faded “REGISTERED” stamp during the fingerprint-mismatch rejection. A few frames also need improved 720p readability or less cramped framing.
